payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute 2D prefix sums of star brightness for each possible time remainder (0..c) using recurrence, then answer rectangle queries in O(1) by looking up the appropriate precomputed grid.
payload.rationale: The code builds a 3D array prec[s][x][y] where for each brightness state s, it fills using a 2D prefix sum recurrence (DP style). Then queries use modulo to select the correct 2D prefix sum array. This fits dp_2d_state as it performs a 2D DP to enable fast queries.
